page_title: TOR 0-1 FIO | Torino v Fiorentina 03/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Torino are ruled offside.
90+5' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
90+4' Fiorentina can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+3' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee points to the corner flag and Fiorentina will take a corner.
90+3' Fiorentina quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+3' Dodo (Fiorentina) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Vanja Milinkovic-Savic pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The referee blows his whistle, Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Edoardo Bove (Fiorentina) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico La Penna had an easy-decision to make.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Yann Karamoh (Torino) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
89' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) probably handled the ball.
87' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) strikes the ball harmlessly from a long-range free kick and it goes high over the bar. It's not easy to score from a distance like that.
86' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
85' A substitution has been made. Moise Kean is replaced by Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina).
84' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Saul Coco (Torino). Federico La Penna saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
83' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
83' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
82' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) will deliver the corner kick.
82' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
82' Alieu Njie (Torino) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
81' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
78' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Samuele Ricci and he is replaced by Karol Linetty (Torino).
78' We are about to witness a subsitution. Yann Karamoh (Torino) for Nikola Vlasic.

78' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
76' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) unleashed a brilliant free kick from the edge of the box and hits the left post of the goal.
75' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Lucas Beltran will be replaced by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina).

74' Samuele Ricci (Torino) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Samuele Ricci (Torino) gets a yellow card. Fiorentina earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
72' The Torino players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
71' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball, though, only brushes the left post.
69' The percentage of ball possession is – 46:54.
67' Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Ivan Ilic (Torino) for a tough tackle.
64' Paolo Vanoli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Borna Sosa (Torino) replacing Nikola Vlasic.
64' Substitution. Adrien Tameze makes his way off the pitch and Ivan Ilic (Torino) comes on as his replacement.
64' Raffaele Palladino prepares a substitution. Riccardo Sottil is replaced by Christian Kouame (Fiorentina).
63' The manager makes a subsitution with Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) coming on for Andrea Colpani.
63' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Amir Richardson walks off the pitch to be replaced by Yacine Adli (Fiorentina).
62' Samuele Ricci (Torino) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
59' Torino couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as David de Gea (Fiorentina) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
58' Alieu Njie (Torino) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.

56' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) latches on to a precise cross on the edge of the box and strikes the ball goalwards. However, it goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
56' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off his line to gather the ball.
53' Dangerous play by Marcus Pedersen (Torino). Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Marcus Pedersen is the provider with a good cross and Adrien Tameze (Torino) shows great determination to get to the ball on the edge of the box, but he blazes it high over the bar.
48' Alieu Njie (Torino) is penalised for a foul. Federico La Penna had a clear view and blows his whistle.
48' Handball by Moise Kean (Fiorentina).
47' The referee blows his whistle as Marcus Pedersen (Torino) was too aggressive in his challenge.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) makes a rough challenge and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Torino due to an offside in the build-up play.
45' The Torino players joy may have been justified, because referee Federico La Penna is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
44' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Guillermo Maripan (Torino) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
43' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) commits a rough challenge and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
41' 0 - 1 Goal! Luca Ranieri produces a great pass that finds Moise Kean (Fiorentina) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
39' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Fiorentina.
37' Shots on target – 0:1.
35' The linesman raises his flag. Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is adjudged offside.
33' Rough tackle by Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Federico La Penna signals.
31' Adrien Tameze (Torino) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
29' Dodo (Fiorentina) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
25' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) serves up a nice cross, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic punches the ball away.
23' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
21' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes.
19' The ball possession is 53:47.
17' Che Adams (Torino) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Alieu Njie replaces him.
16' Che Adams (Torino) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
15' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender. Torino have a corner.
14' Federico La Penna has a clear sight and sees a foul from Amir Richardson (Fiorentina).
12' The ball rebounds out to Nikola Vlasic (Torino) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
11' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Torino comes to nothing.

11' Che Adams (Torino) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block. Torino will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
9' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
7' Saul Coco (Torino) blazes a shot from a long-range free kick and the ball ends somewhere in row Z. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
5' Torino enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
3' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Torino will have the kick-off.
Federico La Penna was nominated as the referee for this game.
